qualification: Proficiency in C++, Java, Python, or Go, with background in algorithms and data structures.
description: Work on real-world projects that impact millions of users across Google Search, Cloud, Android, and AI platforms.

title: Generation Google Scholarship
eligibility: Full-time undergraduate or graduate students pursuing Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
qualification: Demonstrated financial need, strong academic performance, and commitment to diversity and inclusion.
description: Designed to help aspiring computer scientists excel in technology and become leaders in the computing industry.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)

description: Join Canonical's open-source web team to design, build, and maintain web solutions for Ubuntu products and services.

title: Data Analyst - Associate

description: Collaborate with client teams to extract insights from large datasets using SQL, Python, and BI visualization software.

title: Imagine Cup 2025

description: The world's premier student technology competition encouraging students to turn AI-driven solutions into real startup businesses.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
